comments.author: @ນນຮຍຈຄຍຫດ້ານນີນ
comments.text: Of all the countries in Southeast Asia, Laos has the laziest and least friendly people I’ve ever encountered. I’m not saying this without reason — I run a business in Laos. And once you start dealing with people here in a business context, you’ll see their true nature. People here are so lazy that even when you offer them money, they’re still unwilling to make an effort or get anything done. Maybe they drink too much Beerlao, and that’s why they’re perfectly content with the way things are.
